blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: 牙科局部麻醉注射管 (Dental Local Anaesthetic Cartridge)：這是一種小型玻璃管，預填充局部麻醉藥（如利多卡因），牙醫使用專用的注射器將其直接注射入患者口腔組織。ISO 11040-1專門規定這類玻璃管的規格。
blocks.en: Dental Local Anaesthetic Cartridge: A small glass cartridge prefilled with a local anaesthetic (such as lidocaine), which the dentist injects directly into the patient's oral tissue using a dedicated dental syringe. ISO 11040-1 specifies the requirements for these glass cylinders.

blocks.zh: 水解抗性 (Hydrolytic Resistance) HGA 1：玻璃與藥液接觸時，玻璃表面可能溶出鹼性離子，影響藥品pH值和純度。HGA 1是最高水解抗性等級，代表玻璃僅釋放極少量可溶出物，確保藥液不受污染。
blocks.en: Hydrolytic Resistance HGA 1: When glass contacts a drug solution, alkaline ions may leach from the glass surface and affect the pH and purity of the product. HGA 1 is the highest hydrolytic resistance grade, meaning the glass releases only minimal extractable amounts, so the solution is not contaminated.

blocks.zh: 初級包裝材料 (Primary Packaging Material)：直接接觸藥品的容器，是藥品安全的第一道防線。ISO強調其對藥品效力、純度、穩定性的直接影響。
blocks.en: Primary Packaging Material: The container that comes into direct contact with the drug product and is the first line of defence for product safety. ISO stresses its direct impact on the potency, purity and stability of the drug.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 牙科注射管就像一個精密的「迷你安瓿瓶」。想像它是預裝了特定劑量止痛藥的一次性小容器，牙醫只需插入專用注射器，就能精準給藥——類似於預裝好食材的外賣調料包，使用方便且劑量準確。
blocks.en: A dental cartridge is like a precision "mini ampoule". Think of it as a single-use container pre-filled with a specific dose of anaesthetic: the dentist simply loads it into a dedicated syringe and delivers the dose accurately, much like a pre-portioned seasoning sachet that is convenient to use and gives an accurate amount.

blocks.zh: 玻璃的水解抗性就像不鏽鋼鍋與鋁鍋的差異：不鏽鋼（HGA 1玻璃）幾乎不與食物反應，而低等級鋁鍋則可能溶出金屬離子影響食物品質。
blocks.en: Glass hydrolytic resistance is like the difference between a stainless steel pot and an aluminium pot: stainless steel (HGA 1 glass) hardly reacts with food, whereas a lower-grade aluminium pot may leach metal ions that affect food quality.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 9個月提前通知原則：玻璃化學成分的任何變更必須提前9個月通知用戶。這反映出初級包裝的相容性研究（Compatibility Study）需要充分時間——製藥商需要重新測試材料與藥品的相互作用，這個時間窗口保護了患者安全。
blocks.en: The 9-month advance notification principle: Any change to the glass chemical composition must be notified to users 9 months in advance. This reflects the fact that compatibility studies for primary packaging need sufficient time: the drug manufacturer has to retest the interaction between the material and the product, and this time window protects patient safety.

blocks.zh: 殘餘應力限制（40 nm/mm）：退火不充分的玻璃存在內部應力，可能在注射時或消毒過程中突然碎裂，造成人身安全風險。
blocks.en: Residual stress limit (40 nm/mm): Glass that has not been adequately annealed contains internal stress and may suddenly break during injection or sterilisation, creating a risk of personal injury.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼牙科局部麻醉注射管需要1.7 ml、1.8 ml和2.2 ml三種規格？這與哪些臨床操作需求有關？
blocks.en: Why are dental local anaesthetic cartridges needed in three sizes (1.7 ml, 1.8 ml and 2.2 ml)? Which clinical needs does this relate to?

blocks.zh: 玻璃管若含有氣泡（seeds/bubbles），會對臨床使用產生哪些風險？
blocks.en: What risks do seeds/bubbles in the glass cylinder pose in clinical use?

blocks.zh: 當供應商通知玻璃化學成分變更時，CDMO客戶應立即啟動哪些評估程序？
blocks.en: When a supplier notifies a change in glass chemical composition, which assessments should the CDMO's customer start immediately?

blocks.zh: Part 2 — Plunger Stoppers for Dental Local Anaesthetic Cartridges (ISO 11040-2:2011) Part 2 — 牙科局部麻醉藥匣用活塞橡皮塞（ISO 11040-2:2011）
blocks.en: Part 2 — Plunger Stoppers for Dental Local Anaesthetic Cartridges (ISO 11040-2:2011)

blocks.zh: 活塞塞分類 (Type A/B/C)：空腔（Cavity）的設計目的是調整活塞塞的壓縮性和密封性能。Type A無空腔，密封性最強但滑動阻力較大；Type C有兩個空腔，提供較低的啟動力（Break-Loose Force），適合需要精確注射力控制的場合。
blocks.en: Plunger stopper types (Type A/B/C): The purpose of the cavity is to adjust the compressibility and sealing performance of the plunger stopper. Type A has no cavity, giving the strongest seal but higher sliding resistance; Type C has two cavities and gives a lower break-loose force, which suits applications requiring precise control of injection force.

blocks.zh: 間隔器 (Spacers)：高度不超過0.3 mm的微小突起，防止活塞塞疊放時粘連在一起。看似微小的設計，卻對灌裝生產線的自動化進料效率至關重要。
blocks.en: Spacers: Tiny protrusions no more than 0.3 mm high that prevent plunger stoppers from sticking together when stacked. Though a seemingly minor design feature, they are essential to the efficiency of automated feeding on filling lines.

blocks.zh: Shore A 硬度：彈性體材料的硬度標準，直接影響密封性和滑動力。硬度偏高→滑動阻力大，患者注射時費力；硬度偏低→密封性能下降，可能泄漏。±5的公差控制了系統的一致性。
blocks.en: Shore A hardness: The hardness standard for elastomeric materials, which directly affects sealing and sliding force. Higher hardness means greater sliding resistance and a harder injection for the patient; lower hardness weakens sealing and may lead to leakage. The ±5 tolerance controls the consistency of the system.

blocks.zh: 活塞塞就像注射器的「活塞密封圈」。想像汽車引擎的活塞環：它必須與缸壁緊密配合（密封性），但又能順暢滑動（低摩擦）。Type A/B/C就像不同硬度的活塞環，空腔設計就像在活塞環上切槽，使其更容易壓縮、降低啟動阻力。
blocks.en: A plunger stopper is like the "piston seal ring" of the syringe. Think of the piston rings in a car engine: they must fit tightly against the cylinder wall (sealing) yet still slide smoothly (low friction). Types A/B/C are like piston rings of different hardness, and the cavity design is like cutting a groove into the ring so that it compresses more easily and has lower break-loose resistance.

blocks.zh: cGMP要求：ISO 11040-2明確指出彈性體初級包裝組件的製造必須遵循cGMP原則（參考ISO 15378）。這意味著彈性體供應商不僅是工業橡膠製品廠商，更是受GMP監管的藥品包裝材料製造商。
blocks.en: cGMP requirements: ISO 11040-2 explicitly states that elastomeric primary packaging components must be manufactured according to cGMP principles (see ISO 15378). This means an elastomer supplier is not merely an industrial rubber goods manufacturer but a GMP-regulated manufacturer of pharmaceutical packaging materials.

blocks.zh: 「原始測試批次」原則：供應商必須確保每次交貨與最初通過測試並由終端用戶批准的型號樣品（Type Sample）保持一致性，這是藥品供應鏈中的配方鎖定（Formula Lock）概念。
blocks.en: The "original test batch" principle: The supplier must ensure that every delivery is consistent with the type sample that was originally tested and approved by the end user. In the pharmaceutical supply chain this is the concept of a formula lock.

blocks.zh: 滑動特性系統性：標準明確指出滑動特性受到容器密封系統所有組件的影響，包括硅化（Siliconization）處理程度，強調需要系統性評估而非單獨評估組件。
blocks.en: Systemic nature of sliding characteristics: The standard states clearly that sliding characteristics are affected by all components of the container closure system, including the degree of siliconisation, which underlines the need to evaluate the system as a whole rather than the components individually.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: CDMO在評估牙科局部麻醉注射管活塞塞供應商時，應要求提供：(1) 型號樣品認可書；(2) ISO 8871-1和ISO 8871-4測試報告；(3) 高壓滅菌後性能保持的驗證數據；(4) 老化穩定性研究。若客戶要求使用輻射滅菌替代蒸汽滅菌，必須重新評估彈性體材料的適用性。
blocks.en: When assessing plunger stopper suppliers for dental local anaesthetic cartridges, the CDMO should require: (1) the type sample approval; (2) ISO 8871-1 and ISO 8871-4 test reports; (3) validation data showing that performance is retained after autoclaving; (4) ageing stability studies. If the customer asks for radiation sterilisation instead of steam sterilisation, the suitability of the elastomer material must be reassessed.

blocks.zh: 為什麼活塞塞的啟動力（Break-Loose Force）測試需要在完整的容器密封系統中進行，而不是單獨測試活塞塞？
blocks.en: Why must the break-loose force of a plunger stopper be tested in the complete container closure system rather than on the plunger stopper alone?

blocks.zh: 如果彈性體供應商計劃更換橡膠配方，ISO 11040-2要求哪些評估步驟？
blocks.en: If an elastomer supplier plans to change the rubber formulation, which assessment steps does ISO 11040-2 require?

blocks.zh: Part 3 — Seals for Dental Local Anaesthetic Cartridges (ISO 11040-3:2012) Part 3 — 牙科局部麻醉藥匣用密封件（ISO 11040-3:2012）
blocks.en: Part 3 — Seals for Dental Local Anaesthetic Cartridges (ISO 11040-3:2012)

blocks.zh: 密封件結構 (Seal Structure)：牙科注射管密封件由鋁帽（Cap）+ 橡膠圓片（Disc）組成。鋁帽提供機械強度和防篡改保護；橡膠圓片負責密封性和針頭穿刺後的自我封閉性。
blocks.en: Seal structure: The seal of a dental cartridge consists of an aluminium cap plus a rubber disc. The aluminium cap provides mechanical strength and tamper protection; the rubber disc provides the seal and the self-resealing ability after needle puncture.

blocks.zh: 單層/雙層圓片設計 (Type A/B)：Type A單層圓片結構簡單，穿刺力較低；Type B雙層圓片提供更好的密封性和抗針頭碎屑（Fragmentation）能力——針頭穿刺時可能帶出橡膠顆粒進入藥液，這是嚴重的污染風險。
blocks.en: Single-layer/double-layer disc design (Type A/B): The Type A single-layer disc is simple in structure and has a lower puncture force; the Type B double-layer disc gives a better seal and better resistance to needle fragmentation. When a needle punctures the disc it may carry rubber particles into the drug solution, which is a serious contamination risk.

blocks.zh: 碎片測試 (Fragmentation Test)：模擬針頭穿刺橡膠圓片時的碎片產生情況。按ISO 7885標準，使用外徑0.4 mm針頭，評估橡膠碎片脫落量，直接關係到注射安全性。
blocks.en: Fragmentation test: Simulates the generation of fragments when a needle pierces the rubber disc. In accordance with ISO 7885, a needle with an outer diameter of 0.4 mm is used to assess the amount of rubber fragments released, which bears directly on injection safety.

blocks.zh: 密封件就像葡萄酒瓶的軟木塞——它必須密封瓶口（防止液體蒸發和外部污染），同時允許開瓶器（針頭）穿入時不產生過多碎屑落入酒中（防碎片污染）。Type B的雙層設計就像高端葡萄酒使用的複合軟木塞，提供雙重密封保障。
blocks.en: A seal is like the cork of a wine bottle: it must seal the bottle neck (preventing evaporation and external contamination), yet allow the corkscrew (the needle) to pass through without dropping too many crumbs into the wine (fragmentation contamination control). The double-layer Type B design is like the composite corks used for premium wines, giving a double sealing safeguard.

blocks.zh: 鋁帽的陽極氧化/塗層要求：鋁金屬本身可能與某些藥物發生反應，陽極氧化（Anodizing）或適當塗層為鋁帽提供化學惰性保護層。在選擇密封件供應商時，必須確認表面處理規格。
blocks.en: Anodising/coating requirement for the aluminium cap: Aluminium itself may react with certain drugs, so anodising or a suitable coating gives the cap a chemically inert protective layer. When selecting a seal supplier, the surface treatment specification must be confirmed.

blocks.zh: 密封件與活塞塞的組合測試：ISO 11040-3的Annex A說明密封件和活塞塞的泄漏測試可以合併進行（ISO 11040-2 Annex A）。在實際驗證工作中，建議對完整的容器密封系統進行組合測試，而非僅測試單個組件。
blocks.en: Combined testing of seal and plunger stopper: Annex A of ISO 11040-3 explains that the leakage tests for the seal and the plunger stopper can be performed together (ISO 11040-2 Annex A). In practical validation work, it is recommended to test the complete container closure system in combination rather than testing individual components only.

blocks.zh: 生物毒性測試範圍：毒性試驗僅適用於橡膠圓片（disc），不適用於鋁帽，因為鋁帽不直接接觸藥品内部。這體現了ISO標準的科學性——按實際接觸關係確定測試範圍。
blocks.en: Scope of biological toxicity testing: Toxicity tests apply only to the rubber disc and not to the aluminium cap, because the cap does not directly contact the interior of the drug product. This reflects the scientific basis of the ISO standard: the test scope is determined by actual contact relationships.

blocks.zh: 公式與計算 Formula
blocks.en: Formula

blocks.zh:
密封件壓合要求：
  橡膠圓片直徑 > 鋁帽內徑（d1 = 7.5 mm）
  → 確保足夠壓配力（Press-Fit）

泄漏測試條件（Annex A）：
  施力：(30 ± 1) N
  時間：1 min
  樣品數量：10個水填充注射管
  合格標準：0個泄漏
blocks.en:
Seal crimping requirement:
  Rubber disc diameter > aluminium cap inner diameter (d1 = 7.5 mm)
  → Ensures sufficient press-fit force

Leakage test conditions (Annex A):
  Applied force: (30 ± 1) N
  Time: 1 min
  Sample size: 10 water-filled cartridges
  Acceptance criterion: 0 leaks

blocks.zh: 當牙科注射管密封件的供應商計劃更換橡膠圓片的彈性體配方時，作為藥品製造商，你需要執行哪些再確認測試？
blocks.en: When the supplier of a dental cartridge seal plans to change the elastomer formulation of the rubber disc, which requalification tests do you, as the drug manufacturer, need to carry out?

blocks.zh: 碎片測試（Fragmentation Test）的失敗可能導致哪些患者安全風險？如何在設計階段減少這種風險？
blocks.en: What patient safety risks can result from a failed fragmentation test? How can this risk be reduced at the design stage?

blocks.zh: 為什麼密封件的鋁帽必須陽極氧化或塗層？若省略這個步驟會有什麼後果？
blocks.en: Why must the aluminium cap of the seal be anodised or coated? What would be the consequence of omitting this step?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: ISO 11040-1/2/3涵蓋牙科局部麻醉注射管的三個核心組件：玻璃管、活塞塞和密封件，三者共同構成容器密封系統（Container Closure System）
blocks.en: ISO 11040-1/2/3 cover the three core components of dental local anaesthetic cartridges: the glass cylinder, the plunger stopper and the seal, which together form the container closure system

blocks.zh: 玻璃材料須達到最高水解抗性等級（HGA 1 / HC 1），彈性體材料須符合ISO 8871系列要求，確保藥品安全
blocks.en: The glass material must reach the highest hydrolytic resistance grade (HGA 1 / HC 1), and elastomeric materials must meet the requirements of the ISO 8871 series to ensure drug product safety

blocks.zh: 初級包裝組件的任何材料變更，必須提前通知用戶（玻璃：9個月）並進行相容性重新評估，這是供應鏈管理的重要環節
blocks.en: Any material change to a primary packaging component must be notified to users in advance (glass: 9 months) and followed by a compatibility reassessment, which is an important part of supply chain management

blocks.zh: 所有組件的製造均須遵循cGMP原則（ISO 15378），體現了初級包裝材料作為藥品完整性的第一道屏障的重要地位
blocks.en: All components must be manufactured according to cGMP principles (ISO 15378), which reflects the role of primary packaging materials as the first barrier protecting the integrity of the drug product
